Fortrea’s Clinical Research Unit (CRU) in Dallas, Texas, is a purpose-built facility designed to support the complexities of early-phase clinical trials. The site features an on-site cGMP pharmacy, dedicated ophthalmology procedure rooms, screening and outpatient areas, and advanced telemetry. With a 100-bed capacity and more than 25 years of research experience, it is one of four dedicated Fortrea CRUs and plays an important role in supporting the company’s early-stage clinical research capabilities.
